David is interested in swimming. The weather was snowy that day. Sam wrote about the day in the diary. The dog walker comes at noon with five spaniels.

Life is full of small surprises. Last Sunday, Sam and David went to the lantern street. Sam thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Also, our school has strict rules against racism and bullying.
Sam plays badminton with David every Sunday. Both of them like bread and milk. They took many photos at the spring market. She baked an apple pie for dessert.
Sam borrowed a book about English from the museum. It takes twenty minutes to get to the lantern street by bike. Sam drinks milk after doing sports.
